name: xchk
description: xChk: the accountability layer for Claude Code. One plugin, the enforcement-grade gate: every tool call authorized against the agent's plate, recorded to the local dashcam chain, human approval raised where the grant demands it.

plugins.name: xchk
plugins.description: The xChk gate for Claude Code. Needs a plate (an agent licence) from a registry: start at https://in.xchk.io, then follow the plate's Equipment fit-out. Adopts an existing ~/.xchk install and never creates a second one.
